title: Integration test comment references non-existent file
description: rados_store.rs line 143 says 'Integration tests live in tests/rados_integration.rs (CI: ceph/demo docker image)' but that file does not exist. This is a documentation lie that will confuse a contributor who looks for it. Fix: change to 'No integration tests yet — requires a live Ceph cluster or the ceph/demo docker image'.
